item.title: Version 0.7.3
item.description:
Recall 0.7.3

Improvements

  • Smart Return suggests browser projects the same day. If you put real time (25+ min) into a browser-based project — research, analytics, a web app — Smart Return can now bring it back the same day, instead of waiting until you've worked on it across two separate days.

item.title: Version 0.7.2
item.description:
Recall 0.7.2

Fixes

  • Drift nudges now name what you were working on. When you stepped away — say, into a meeting — the "you drifted" nudge showed a generic "your last thread." It now names the actual project or task you left, so it's clear what to come back to.

item.title: Version 0.7.1
item.description:
Recall 0.7.1

Fixes

  • Smart Return now appears after an overnight or weekend break. Opening your laptop in the morning is the most common moment to want "here's where you left off" — but Recall was only looking back 8 hours, so after a longer gap it surfaced nothing. It now reliably brings back your most recent thread after overnight and weekend breaks.

item.title: Version 0.7.0
item.description:
Recall 0.7.0

New

  • New on-device AI model — Ministral-3. Screen understanding now runs on Mistral AI's Ministral-3 vision model (replacing Qwen 3.5-VL) for faster, more reliable frame analysis. It auto-downloads on first launch.
  • Project tracking for browser-only work. If you mostly work in a browser (marketing, research, analytics, AI assistants), Recall now builds Projects and Smart Return for you too — provisional projects form from what you're actually working on and mature into full projects over time. Still no manual tagging.

Improvements

  • Video meetings now count as interruptions. Zoom / Google Meet / Teams calls drop focus and surface a drift nudge; async chat (Slack, etc.) stays "reactive" and is saved silently.
  • Smart Return appears promptly on return. Fixed a bug where coming back from a long break could leave the re-entry panel ~1 min late or missing entirely.
  • "Too many threads" only when truly overloaded — now requires 3+ distinct projects instead of firing on a single thread.
  • Saved-for-later threads always resurface on return, even without an assigned topic.

Under the hood

  • Faster inference (1024px frames + VisionZip), chat-template fix, image token-cache (VLCache), helper-process hardening.
  • Removed the legacy screenshot-captures debug store (reclaims significant disk).

item.title: Version 0.2.0
item.description:
# Recall 0.2.0
## Features
- feat(release): notes draft, Sparkle sign, appcast push, tag, gh release - feat(release): --publish flag with preflight + version bump - feat(settings): Check for Updates… button in About section - feat(updater): wire UpdaterService into ServiceContainer + AppDelegate - feat(updater): UpdaterService wraps Sparkle with MAS-receipt gate - feat(launch-at-login): register Recall as a login item - feat(behavior-mode): make LiveMode the canonical driver, drop the toggle - feat(helper): instrument RecallHelper with Sentry - feat(distribution): non-sandbox DMG ship + onboarding polish
## Fixes
- fix(popover): wrap re-entry title/question and put `?` at the end - fix(downloader): heal existing tokenizer_config.json on every launch - fix(downloader): patch tokenizer_class on download to keep swift-transformers happy
## Performance
- perf(screen-analysis): slow cadence to 30s on base-tier Apple GPUs
## Other
- release: v0.2.0 - chore(plist): wire Sparkle feed URL + EdDSA public key - chore(deps): add Sparkle 2.x for auto-updates - chore(build): silence build warnings - tune(qwen): per-prompt sampling profiles + raise vision input to 2558px
